note: docs/design/FLOOR.md Appendix B row 15's camera and capability-floor runs (card#7341) — AT-D3-21's floor half. Every run replays § 11's fixtures byte for byte — `fx-snapshot-4` through `fx-scene.json`'s `scene_default` and `scene_overflow` (the shipped default map, `@json:`), `fx-gap`'s resync pair, `fx-layout-acts`' `room.map`, `fx-drilldown`'s `fleet.health`, `fx-degraded`'s snapshot and `fx-floor-plan`'s failing room map — at a viewport each run states (`floor.viewport`, CSS px) and with the viewer's camera acts on the scenario clock (`floor.camera`, `fleet-client-probe.mjs`'s header). F is § 12's viewport floor, and the test holds each run's stated viewport to the figure § 12 states.

camera_floor.note: AT-D3-21's floor half, the camera leg (Appendix B row 15): `fx-snapshot-4`'s four seats on the SHIPPED default map (`@json:`, the file itself) at a viewport of § 12's viewport floor, F. The viewer zooms with the wheel at a stated cursor point, drags by a stated offset, fits the floor, zooms in again three notches, drags, drags far past the floor's edge (the clamp), and drags once more — then the fleet sends a `seat.delta` (1000 ms), a `seat.delta` past a gap that resyncs the seat by fetch (2000 ms, `fx-gap`'s pair and its seat response), a `room.map` that re-fetches the room at version 4 (2500 ms, `fx-layout-acts`' message), and ends the stream (3000 ms), so the recovery reconnects and applies a second full snapshot. Every frame after the last camera act must carry the camera that act left. With the camera acts removed (an override of the page conditions) it is the discriminating control: the scene at fit and the log carrying exactly the messages' rows.

camera_proportional.note: AT-D3-21's floor half, the wheel's scale (round-1 finding F1 on PupFuzz/mezzanine#237): `scene_default` at F, and the wheel as a trackpad drives it — a burst of 25 pixel-mode events of 4 px each, one notch's scroll in all — then a line-mode event (3 lines), a page-mode event (one page out) and an accelerated pixel event of 250 px, then a pinch — a burst of small `ctrlKey` pixel events, each scaled by `PINCH_GAIN`, and one fast `ctrlKey` event that the gain takes past a notch — then the keyboard's zoom in and out about the centre. Every wheel event must zoom by `ZOOM_STEP` to the power of its scroll over a notch, `deltaMode` normalised, a pinch's scroll multiplied by `PINCH_GAIN` and one event holding at most one notch after it, and the burst by one notch in all — where a step per event takes it 25 steps, to the ceiling. The run stays between the fit and the ceiling throughout, so no zoom here is the range's clamp.

camera_nothing_measurable.note: AT-D3-21's floor half, a floor with nothing measurable on it (round-1 finding F4 on PupFuzz/mezzanine#237): `fx-snapshot-4`'s snapshot, byte for byte, beside a layout whose one floor holds one room the fleet reports no seat for (§ 4.6), and that room's map request failing as `fx-floor-plan`'s `plan_map_fails` fails it, byte for byte — no footprint, no desk, so the scene is drawn with no extent (`null`, as § 4.6's own extent is: no zero-sized box). The render must still paint — the status strip among it — with the camera unframed, and the viewer's acts on it move nothing.
